original: WPRPLACE is a ribbon lake in Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, north-central Poland, near the city of Gniezno. It gives its name to the protected area called WPRPLACE Landscape Park.
translated: WPRPLACE ist ein Bandsee in der Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Nord-Zentralpolen, in der Nähe der Stadt Gniezno. Es gibt seinen Namen dem geschützten Bereich namens WPRPLACE Landscape Park.
